item.title: [156] TLOK
item.description:
People didn’t want growth, they wanted another plot-armored comfort show like ATLA and got pissed when the writers actually matured.

Korra’s trauma across four seasons wasn’t the writers “ruining” her legacy. It was them refusing to hand her the same invincible-hero safety net Aang got. They made her lose, break, deal with real PTSD, and still choose to keep going. That’s not bad writing that’s modern, adult storytelling.

Aang was the idealized Avatar. Korra was the human one. The fact that we’re still arguing about it years later proves it worked.

Original filename: img_1111.jpg

Food costs in the United States have soared in recent years. https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/31/politics/doj-admits-reflecting-pool-renovation-flawed-drops-case-david-hearn

The Justice Department is admitting that a President Donald Trump-prompted $14 million renovation on the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool in Washington, DC, was flawed, and is dropping the criminal case against former Olympian David Hearn that accused him of damaging the pool, according to a new court filing from DC US Attorney Jeanine Pirro.

“It was not until after the return of the indictment [of Hearn], that the [Department of Interior] provided additional documents to the [US Attorney’s Office in DC] indicating that damage to the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool in June 2026 was the result of flawed installation by the contractor, Atlantic Industrial Coatings, and the rush to complete the project prior to events associated with the America 250 celebration in the weeks surrounding Independence Day 2026,” Pirro’s office wrote.

Hearn’s attorneys said in a statement reacting to the decision, “The Trump administration’s case against David Hearn should never have been brought. Its dismissal today does not erase the abuse of government power in arresting and charging a patriotic American who did nothing wrong. The government’s approach was ready, fire, aim. The administration owes Mr. Hearn an apology.”

When CNN called the contracting company Friday evening, an employee with Atlantic Industrial Coatings said they hadn’t heard anything about the new filing, adding, “No comment.”

item.title: [ 31] Can I put dead raccoons into a chipper shredder?
item.description:
This is a serious question. I have some land to clear for fruit bushes and fruit trees, and will be milling the larger logs into timbers for other projects. But, I plan to get a chain flail type chipper shredder to to turn all the leftover slash into mulch and compost for the fruit. The land has a lot of raccoons who love to destroy berry bushes. I'm wondering if anyone here has experience putting dead raccoons through a chipper shredder to add nitrogen and minerals to their compost. I'm guessing I'll be making around 4 or 5 tons of mulch and have anywhere from 80 to 120 raccoons to add to it. If anyone has tried putting raccoons or comparable mammals - jackrabbits, beavers, coyotes, etc. - into woodchippers I'd like to hear about your experience.

I'd rather not bury dozens of whole carcasses in my compost pile, and if shredded I assume the raccoon material would compost faster and mix in better. And yes, during fur season I'd save the pelts - unfortunately most of the shooting and trapping would occur during the summer months since that's when they'd be after my berries and plums.

Try to look online for interesting things, you can blow out KL in like 2.5 weeks of going out, and everyone just says "never run out of things,,," and don't get me started at 5AM singing.

Is there any saving grace for this place?

item.title: [ 52] Homeless OUT
item.description:
I'm here, but I'm gonna find myself homeless in the next few months, what do I need to be a hobo? So far I have
>tent
>backpack
>two ponchos
>a few tarps
>a butane stove
>sleeping bag
>tent fold up mattress
Thing is I'm not sure I can carry all this on my back at the same time, at least not without walking extremely slowly.
I'm mildly disabled and broke my spine a few years ago and I'm worried about being bogged down with gear, especially considering my tent is a large, pop-up tent that doesn't dissassemble into parts
>just use your car
If I use my car the local cops will take it off me, being poor and homeless is not allowed in Ireland and they'll take everything off me

So should I get a new tent? or is there a backpack that I can get that will allow me to carry a tent and mattress easily, even if I'm using a crutch to walk?

Thanks anons, I'm hoping you guys can help me plan my homelessness a bit better cos I've not been camping in years
